provenance.source: UN WPP 2024 (population) + ILO/World Bank (participation) + Penn World Table 10.01 (productivity)
provenance.licence: see per-entry sources; UN WPP: CC BY 3.0 IGO, PWT 10.01: CC BY 4.0, ILOSTAT/WB: CC BY 4.0
provenance.notes: Documented, sourced per-region annual growth trajectories for the Phase 7b.2 structural drivers (demographic + productivity). Rates are decimal fractions per year, entered as dated knots from the cited published figures; the wrapper holds the most recent knot piecewise-constant. Regions are the model's illustrative multi-region labels N (North, a developed-economy proxy) and S (South, an emerging-economy proxy) plus a global __all__ default; on a real EXIOBASE build these map to actual country/region trajectories via the same loader.

sources.population:N: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Medium variant — annual population growth rate for high-income regions (approx +0.3%/yr 2025 declining to negative by 2050). https://population.un.org/wpp/
sources.population:S: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Medium variant — annual population growth rate for less-developed regions (approx +1.2%/yr 2025 declining toward +0.5%/yr 2050). https://population.un.org/wpp/
sources.population:__all__: UN World Population Prospects 2024, Medium variant — world annual population growth (approx +0.8%/yr 2025 to +0.3%/yr 2050). https://population.un.org/wpp/
sources.labour_participation:N: ILOSTAT / World Bank labour-force participation modelled estimates — high-income economies: broadly flat, mild decline with ageing. https://ilostat.ilo.org/
sources.labour_participation:S: ILOSTAT / World Bank labour-force participation modelled estimates — emerging economies: mild rise from rising female participation, tapering. https://ilostat.ilo.org/
sources.labour_participation:__all__: ILOSTAT / World Bank global labour-force participation — approximately flat/mild rise. https://ilostat.ilo.org/
sources.productivity:N: Penn World Table 10.01, TFP growth at constant national prices (rtfpna) — advanced economies ~1.0-1.2%/yr trend. Feenstra, Inklaar & Timmer (2015), AER; https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/productivity/pwt/
sources.productivity:S: Penn World Table 10.01, TFP/labour-productivity growth — emerging economies convergence ~2.2-3.0%/yr trend. Feenstra, Inklaar & Timmer (2015), AER; https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/productivity/pwt/
sources.productivity:__all__: Penn World Table 10.01, world-average productivity growth ~1.7%/yr. Feenstra, Inklaar & Timmer (2015), AER; https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/productivity/pwt/
